Product Details: Ultra-Fast Charging: The ENVIE SprintX Rechargeable Batteries Charger is designed for quick and efficient charging of AA and AAA Ni-MH batteries, reducing downtime and ensuring your devices are always powered up. Complete Battery Set: This charger includes two AA 2800mAh and two AAA 1100mAh rechargeable batteries, providing a comprehensive power solution for a variety of devices straight out of the box. Advanced Protection Features: Equipped with overcharge, overvoltage, and short circuit protection, this charger ensures the safety of both the batteries and the charger, protecting against potential electrical hazards. Dual Input Support: With support for both Type-C and Micro USB inputs, this charger offers versatile charging options, allowing you to power it up using a variety of devices and adapters. Auto Cut & Bad Cell Detection: The charger automatically detects when batteries are fully charged and cuts off charging to prevent overcharging, while also identifying and handling bad cells for optimal performance and safety. Long-lasting Performance: Designed to last up to 5 years and rechargeable up to 500 times, these batteries offer durability and reliability, providing consistent power for your devices over an extended period.
